items.title: Kali Linux vs Parrot OS – Which Penetration Testing Platform is Most Suitable for Cybersecurity Professionals?
items.description: Penetration testing and ethical hacking have been dominated by specialized Linux distributions designed to provide security professionals with comprehensive toolsets for vulnerability assessment and network analysis.
